session.by_date's description promises 'the same night hrv.by_date and sleep.by_date return', but entry(onDate:) takes any overnight (unreliable .insufficient/.preSleep partials included) and never a nap/quick, while OvernightArchive.byDate takes only reliable overnight/nap/quick entries. On a day whose only overnight is a partial, session.by_date returns that partial while hrv.by_date/sleep.by_date return nil or a nap, so the two routes report different sessions for the same date.
